description: Address 3 remaining issues from v2 code review: partial reservation orphan on conflict, unrestricted invoice UPDATE policy, and silent reservation leak on release
steps: Fix issue 1 in orders.ts: Add compensating rollback logic in confirmOrder that tracks successful reservations and reverses them if any item fails the optimistic check
Fix issue 2 in migration 006: Add a BEFORE UPDATE trigger on invoices that restricts non-manager updates to only payment-related columns, and document the rationale
Fix issue 3 in orders.ts and fulfillment.ts: Add .select('id') + length check to reservation release in shipOrder and cancelOrder, throw on mismatch
acceptance_criteria: confirmOrder rolls back previously reserved items when a conflict occurs on any subsequent item
Invoice UPDATE policy has a documented safeguard (trigger or comment) limiting column scope
shipOrder and cancelOrder throw an error when reservation release fails to match rows
pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm zero errors
findings: All 3 v2 review issues fixed. Build passes (tsc -b + vite build). Issue 1: Added rollbackReservations() helper that tracks successful reservations and compensates on conflict. Issue 2: Added BEFORE UPDATE trigger (restrict_invoice_update_columns) that silently resets protected columns for non-manager users. Issue 3: Added .select('id') + length check to both shipOrder and cancelOrder reservation release loops. pnpm install has a supply-chain policy issue with baseline-browser-mapping package but the build commands run directly without issue.
